title: JustinGuitar Beginner Course Grade 1 Introduction — Lesson Structure, Fundamentals, and Practice Routine
summary: This 1:15-long opening video from JustinGuitar introduces the Beginner Guitar Course Grade 1 by explaining that lessons are structured like private sessions, and that the first lesson covers essential fundamentals beyond technique (reading chord boxes, holding the guitar, and how to hold picks). It also outlines a full daily practice routine and notes a left-handed learning option in the Nitsuj series. Because remote learning precludes in-person tuning, Justin instructs that students must learn to tune their guitar themselves, with tuning addressed in the next lesson.
topics: goals and ambitions discussion in lessons

sections.title: Welcome to my Beginner Guitar Course!
sections.description: The instructor outlines that the lessons mimic private tutoring, notes that the first lesson is longer to cover fundamentals (reading chord boxes, holding the guitar, picking), introduces a full daily practice routine, mentions the left-handed Nitsuj series for additional practice, and explains remote-learning constraints by stating students must learn to tune their guitars themselves and that tuning will be addressed in the next lesson.
